name: Kanehl Fabrication
old_description: Kanehl Fabrication offers a comprehensive suite of metal fabrication services, specializing in stainless steel. With advanced capabilities like laser cutting, welding, and complex assembly, we cater to a diverse range of industries, from food processing to industrial OEMs. Our emphasis on precision, coupled with a strong engineering partnership with clients, ensures that every project is executed to the highest standards of quality and efficiency.
about:
Kanehl Fabrication was founded in 2006 in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. The company began as a metal fabrication shop and has since expanded its capabilities through strategic investments in technology and facilities.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication services, specializing in stainless steel. Core processes include laser cutting, CNC bending, welding, machining, metal finishing, and assembly. The facility handles projects from prototype through production, though specific capacity figures are not published.

Kanehl serves customers in food processing, industrial OEM, aerospace, and construction sectors. The company emphasizes engineering collaboration with clients to develop components that integrate directly into OEM assemblies and meet industry-specific requirements.

Leadership cites continuous investment in advanced machinery — such as CNC laser cutting systems — and a philosophy of challenging conventional fabrication methods as key differentiators. The firm also highlights its engineering partnerships and commitment to quality as reasons clients choose them for complex metalwork.
